summary: @hrmony/kit-5 exfiltrates AWS IMDS credentials, environment variables, and Kubernetes service-account secrets on install and on require
details: The package runs credential-harvesting code at two automatic trigger points. The declared preinstall script scripts/check-setup.mjs, invoked by npm install, queries the AWS EC2 IMDSv2 metadata service to retrieve IAM role security credentials, dumps the entire process.env, and recursively reads /var/run/secrets/ (Kubernetes service-account tokens and mounted secrets), then POSTs the collected data to the hardcoded endpoint https://hrnmn.dd.h4x.tv/save_instance_info_hook. The package main index.js performs the same IMDSv2 IAM-credential harvest, full process.env dump, and recursive read of /var/run/secrets/ as top-level module code, POSTing the results to https://hrnmn.dd.h4x.tv/save_instance_info_index; this fires on any require or import of the package. The destination host hrnmn.dd.h4x.tv is unrelated to any legitimate npm registry, cloud provider, or documented package purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
